message: No detected input validation: No checks on structure, type, dtype, shape, or value ranges are performed on any inputs (Ns, Ws, n_max, repetitions, loaded pickles, or generated arrays).

No detected untrusted source handling: All data is generated locally or read from local filesystem paths; no remote sources (URLs, S3, HuggingFace Hub, etc.) are used, so no integrity verification or authentication is applicable or present.

No detected label flipping detection: There is no validation of label distributions, no check against an expected label set, and no use of any label-noise detection tool anywhere in the data preparation pipeline.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The code performs no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs on the generated training or test samples before saving or using them.

No detected model integrity verification: The load_model function in generate_predictions.py loads a serialized Keras model from a plain filesystem path with no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or detects anomalous training samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection implemented anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: The code uses standard Keras/Adam optimizer with no differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) applied.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) or any adversarial stress tests are used anywhere in the evaluation pipeline.

No detected metric tampering protection: While train/test splitting is performed during model training, the evaluation (generate_predictions) uses only a single averaged prediction metric with no signed/hashed data integrity checks, no multiple independent metrics, and the test set is not strictly isolated from the training pipeline (both
No detected input sanitization: The inference path in generate_predictions.py loads pickled test data and passes it directly to model.predict() without any shape, range, or schema validation.
No detected output bounds checks: After model.predict(), the predictions are zipped and averaged with no NaN guards, probability bounds checks, or threshold validation before being saved.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a CNN-based physics ML pipeline (not an LLM), so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
